name: Menu
description: Keyboard-navigable menu family: MenuGroup with roving focus and typeahead; MenuButton, MenuCheckboxItem, MenuRadioItem, MenuLabel, MenuShortcut, MenuSeparator and MenuSub rows; showShadcnMenu helper; MenuPopup surface. Owns MenuPopupTheme and MenubarTheme for the wave-D menu consumers.

fields.background: StateValue<ThemedColor>? - per-state row fill; hovered/focused = accent
fields.textStyle: TextStyle? - label style; its colour is ignored

fields.surfaceBlur: double? - null = the app theme's surfaceBlur

fields.border: bool? - whether the bar draws its border; null = true

accessibility.keyboard: one tab stop per group (roving tabindex): ArrowUp/Down move and wrap, Home/End jump, Enter/Space activates (toggles checkbox/radio), ArrowRight opens the submenu, ArrowLeft closes one level, Escape closes one level (all at the root), typing selects by prefix with a 600 ms buffer
accessibility.semantics: rows are buttons through Clickable; disabled rows dim to 50% opacity

notes: The old module imported material.dart for Divider/VerticalDivider; the separator is a themed 1px box now (MenuSeparator).
The eleven Data.maybeOf reads are foundation Data, not data_widget.
MenuButton rows were old Button widgets with ButtonVariance.menu/menubar; they are Clickable rows now, so menu declares no component deps.
Sheet/dialog overlay sniffing is deleted: popovers paint one surface everywhere.
MenubarState coupling is deleted; the menubar component (B20) owns it and imports MenubarTheme from here.
MenuGap is deleted; use the foundation Gap.
Checkbox/radio rows keep the menu open (autoClose false) vs radio picks dismiss (autoClose true); both are overridable.

Row painting (RovingRow, MenuPopupSurface, showMenuPopover, static rows) lives in primitives/menu_rows.dart on resolved values so wave-D consumers reuse it; every row resolves its four theme legs in menu.dart.

Arrow keys reach the roving engine because the row surface rebinds them to an unbound intent; the Clickable framework traversal would otherwise swallow them (no wrap, no disabled-skip, no submenu keys).
